episodes.title: Cris
episodes.summary: Cris is living her dream in the Dominican Republic, until a phone call from her sister turns everything into a nightmare. Now she's helping hide a body.

episodes.title: Paula
episodes.summary: Paula discovers Elena isn't telling her and Cris the whole truth. But her own secrets cause her to lash out at strangers, attracting unwanted attention.

episodes.title: Elena
episodes.summary: Feeling desperate and alone, Elena tries everything to solve her problem and save Ane, even asking her father for help. Paula's lies make things worse.

episodes.title: Luisa
episodes.summary: Luisa suspects Paula is hiding something and does some digging of her own. An effort to confront the sisters reveals the truth is worse than she fears.

episodes.title: Javier
episodes.summary: Javier is a man of faith, but nothing matters more than his daughters. As time runs out and the police close in, he might be doing more harm than good.

episodes.title: Ane
episodes.summary: For years, Ane has tried to piece together what really happened to her mother that night. Will a trip back to where it all began set them both free?
